source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιοι Δώδεκα Μάρτυρες οι Ρωμαίοι»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is counted and not enumerated — the page names none of the twelve — so it is one folder and not twelve. Its whole notice is one sentence, that they were martyred by the sword, and there is no country beyond old Rome, no century, no emperor and no hymn. The corpus's `forty-roman-martyrs` is a different and larger company on another day and nothing here is claimed about the two. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
